profile.name: Anirudh Sharma
profile.headline_pre: Android apps that feel alive in
profile.bio: I'm **Anirudh Sharma**, a mobile engineer in Bengaluru with 4+ years across consumer, POS, and Android TV apps, now Senior Software Engineer at Origin Fresh. Kotlin-first, Compose-native — happiest wiring up WebSockets, offline-first sync, and CI/CD pipelines that ship themselves.
profile.contact_blurb: Open to senior Android and mobile roles, plus freelance builds — consumer apps, Android TV, React Native, or full-stack with a Node.js backend. Email is the fastest route; I reply within a day.

projects.title: Shipped & in the wild
projects.sub: Production apps on Google Play — from fresh-produce marketplaces to TV discovery to open source.

projects.title: Wholesale Mandi
projects.description: Fresh-produce ordering for customers across Bengaluru and Chennai. I own the Android architecture: MVVM with strict Hilt DI, a modular move to Jetpack Compose, and Remote Config flags for A/B-tested rollouts without app-store waits.

projects.title: Origin Fresh
projects.description: Fresh fruits and veggies, with an AI recipe generator on Google Gemini and Razorpay payments confirmed by webhook.

projects.title: TLDR by LumioLabs
projects.description: Movies, shows, music and live sports from every platform in one place. I built the real-time Android TV experience and the phone-to-TV launch flow.

projects.title: Dossier
projects.description: Self-hosted AI job-search app. I shipped its Claude connector and Startups discovery across YC and Hacker News hiring posts.

projects.title: EHO-Partner
projects.description: Emergency dispatch with live Maps tracking, WebSocket broadcasts, Razorpay, and offline-first sync that survives network dropouts.

experiences.summary: Consumer and POS Android apps for a fresh-produce business — Bengaluru.
points: Ship Wholesale Mandi (100K+ downloads, 4.1★) and Origin Fresh (10K+, 4.4★) on Google Play across Bengaluru and Chennai
Led the modular XML → Jetpack Compose migration, speeding up feature delivery by 35%
Built an AI recipe generator on Google Gemini inside the Origin Fresh app
Own mobile architecture across consumer and POS apps with MVVM and strict Dagger-Hilt DI
Razorpay payments with webhook-driven confirmation for reliable order status
Remote Config feature flags and A/B tests, cutting app-store update cycles for critical rollouts

experiences.summary: Real-time content discovery across phone and Android TV.
points: Built and shipped TLDR by LumioLabs (50K+ downloads), unifying movies, shows, music, and live sports
Real-time Android TV features in Compose over Socket.IO for 10,000+ concurrent users
GitHub Actions CI/CD that cut manual build and deploy time by 50%
Phone-to-TV launch flow over FCM, starting content on the TV from your phone
Fixed a critical multi-threading race condition with Coroutines/Flow-driven state

experiences.summary: Android plus the backend behind it — remote, end to end.
points: Designed Node.js + MongoDB backend services, consumed in-app via Retrofit and Coroutines
Firebase Authentication, FCM, and Analytics for security and user retention
Set UI regression test plans with Product, Design, and QA for zero-defect production releases

experiences.summary: First taste of large, multi-module Android at scale.
points: Memory-leak isolation, performance tuning, and refactoring across multi-module codebases, improving cold-start times
Moved high-traffic user flows from legacy views to Jetpack Compose, simplifying state management
